compiled_state.title: UPDATE: Enumerate merge-to-main-pr.sh _check_duplicate_pr callers and add per-consumer regression tests
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: UPDATE

Enumerate all callers of merge-to-main-pr.sh (which contains _check_duplicate_pr), verify each behaves correctly under the S4 amendment (draft-PR-only filter), and add regression tests. Depends on S4 GREEN task 460f-3fb0-5855-493d (amendment applied).

## Consumer Enumeration (Research First)

Run: grep -r 'merge-to-main-pr\|merge-to-main\.sh' plugins/dso/skills/ plugins/dso/scripts/ --include='*.sh' --include='*.md' -l

Known callers of merge-to-main.sh (which calls merge-to-main-pr.sh):
1. sprint/SKILL.md Phase I → /dso:end-session → merge-to-main.sh (sprint creates draft PR in Phase A)
2. debug-everything/SKILL.md Phase L → merge-to-main.sh (no draft PR created in debug-everything flow)
3. end-session/SKILL.md → merge-to-main.sh directly
4. fix-bug/SKILL.md → /dso:end-session → merge-to-main.sh

## Per-Consumer Behavior Under Amended Guard

For each caller, the amended _check_duplicate_pr filters to non-draft PRs only (isDraft == false). Expected behavior:
1. **Sprint path**: draft PR exists from Phase A → guard passes (draft filtered out), proceeds to merge
2. **debug-everything path**: no draft PR → guard passes (no PR at all)
3. **end-session path**: no draft PR → guard passes
4. **fix-bug path**: no draft PR → guard passes

## Regression Tests

File: tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr-consumer-compat.sh (or extend existing test file)

Use gh stub (PATH-prepended) to simulate each scenario:
1. Sprint scenario: gh returns one draft PR + function runs → no 'existing PR' error emitted
2. fix-bug/debug scenario: gh returns no PRs → no 'existing PR' error emitted
3. Blocked case: gh returns one non-draft PR → 'existing PR' error emitted (guard fires)

## Caller Enumeration Comment Block

Add a comment block near _check_duplicate_pr definition in merge-to-main-pr.sh:
